messages:
Eli (Design): Quick UX flag: on narrow phones the dashboard table cells push past the left rail when there's a long repo/name string. Looks like the cell doesn't respect the rail width and creates a scroll-jump when the sticky header snaps.
Nora (Product): Can you repro? Which breakpoints?
Eli (Design): Repro on 360px and 375px widths. Happens when left rail is expanded. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/mock/rail-overlap.png
Raj (Frontend): Reproduced locally in Chrome mobile emulation. The issue is the table uses min-width: 720px in one of our helper classes (legacy). It was intended for wide cards but leaks into responsive tables.
Marta (Mobile): Also seeing it inside Android WebView where the sticky header and rail z-index fight on fast scroll. The rail briefly overlays actionable chips and makes them untappable.
Nora (Product): Prioritization? Customer-facing bug?
Eli (Design): Medium priority — affects mobile workflows for small accounts but not all customers. UX annoyance but can cause lost taps.
Raj (Frontend): Quick proposal: 1) remove legacy min-width from table helper; 2) at <=380px collapse left rail to icon-only rail (36px) and move any persistent filters into a top sheet; 3) truncate long cell content with ellipsis and show full value in row menu. CSS snippets: `.table-helper { min-width: unset; } .cell { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }`
Marta (Mobile): For WebView, add `-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch` to any horizontal rails and ensure we set `overscroll-behavior: contain` to avoid bounce. Also add small delay on header snap to avoid overlap flash.
Eli (Design): UX variants I'd like to explore: A) collapse-to-icons rail + persistent top filter button, B) auto-hide rail on scroll down and reveal on pull, C) always full-bleed table with swipe-to-open rail. I lean toward A for discoverability.
Nora (Product): A seems safest. For Dedicated customers we can add a feature toggle to keep full rail. Add to backlog for sprint X+1 unless we see error spikes.
Raj (Frontend): Accessibility items: when we collapse rail, expose a visible "Open navigation" affordance with 44px hit area and `aria-expanded`. Use `aria-live` to announce "Navigation collapsed". Also ensure truncated text has accessible tooltip content via `aria-label`.
A11y-Bot: Automated check: recommend contrast >=4.5 for icon-only rail states and ensure focus order is preserved when rail collapses. Logged a11y task RDC-A11Y-221.
Eli (Design): Copy tweak: change tooltip for collapsed nav from "Nav" to "Open navigation". Also ensure tooltips are long-press accessible on mobile (no hover).
Marta (Mobile): I'll prototype the collapsed rail pattern in WKWebView and Android System WebView. Will test gestures and focus ring behavior on Pixel 4a and iPhone SE.
Raj (Frontend): I'll remove the min-width and add responsive media queries: `@media (max-width: 380px) { .sidebar { width: 48px; } .table { margin-left: 48px; } }` and push a draft branch.
Nora (Product): Great. Next steps: Raj draft PR + link to RDC-1210, Marta validate on devices, Eli mock collapsed state for visual review. Tag me when PR is ready for review.
Eli (Design): Thanks — I'll upload mocks and add microcopy suggestions.
Raj (Frontend): Linking draft in ticket in a bit. :shipit:
